workflow_yaml:
title: Order documents
workflow_definition:
  parameters: []
  blocks:
  - block_type: code
    label: extract_order_documents
    code: |
      await page.goto("https://documents.fixture.test/orders")
      rows = page.locator("#order-documents tbody tr")
      await rows.first.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
      return {"documents": await rows.all_text_contents()}
goal: Return every order-document row from the order documents table on this page, with its visible text.
